presentation.title: 👋 Hi, I'm Florent
presentation.subtitle: Backend .NET Developer — future Provençal seeking a permanent position
presentation.seekingJobBanner: Available for a permanent position from September 2026 — Toulon · Aix-en-Provence · Marseille
presentation.locationBadge: Currently in Amiens — Moving to Provence in September 2026
presentation.firstParagraph1: Originally from Nogent-le-Rotrou, in the heart of Normandy's Perche region, I grew up surrounded by nature and a growing curiosity for technology.
presentation.firstParagraph2: It all started at age 14 with the discovery of Python — a true revelation. The Computer Science elective in high school only amplified that passion.
presentation.firstParagraph3: I then built my foundation in Amiens with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the IUT, before going further with a Master's in Cloud Computing & Mobility at INSSET in Saint-Quentin — a demanding program that I fully embraced as an apprentice at Orange Business.
presentation.secondParagraph: I'm a Backend Developer specialized in .NET & C#. My playground: clean RESTful APIs, solid clean architecture, SQL Server, and well-thought-out dependency injection. I also do front-end work with Vue.js — which gives me a useful dual perspective for documenting my APIs precisely. But backend is where I truly thrive.
presentation.philosophyText: Before writing a single line of code, I make sure I fully understand the business need and the end goal. I start by designing the database architecture and API contracts, then build brick by brick, keeping code clean, testable, and maintainable. When a bug hits, no band-aids — I trace it to the root, fix the flaw, and write a test to make sure it never comes back.
presentation.goalText:
Upon completing my Master's degree and work-study program in September 2026, I am relocating back to Provence to be closer to my family and build the next chapter of my career.

Having developed a strong expertise and passion for the Microsoft ecosystem and automation, I am actively seeking a permanent position as a .NET Developer or DevOps Engineer.

My goal is to join a challenging tech team in Toulon, Aix-en-Provence, or Marseille, where I can design robust backend architectures, streamline deployments via CI/CD, and contribute to ambitious projects where code quality is paramount.
presentation.goalCTA: Seeking .NET / DevOps CDI (Toulon, Aix, Marseille) — from Sept. 2026
